title: Step 3: Optimizing Ad Selection - UCB & Multi-Armed Bandit Algorithm Explained

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this ad tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So let's pick up where we left off, that is let's try to figure out why we're using this upper bound equal to this very large number, 10 of the power of 400 given to this upper bound variable
cues.zh: 接續上次，想想為什麼在 else 裡，把 upper_bound 設成這個非常大的 10 的 400 次方，

cues.en: here in this else condition.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: Well, let's see what happens.
cues.zh: 看看會發生什麼。

cues.en: Let's see what happens at first round.
cues.zh: 先看第一回合。

cues.en: Well, at first round we will go through the 10 versions of the ad thanks to this for I loop here.
cues.zh: 第一回合，透過這裡 for i 走遍十個廣告版本。

cues.en: And since at the first round no ad was selected, well, this condition here, if numbers of selections, I, is higher than zero will never be true.
cues.zh: 因為還沒選任何廣告，所以 numbers_of_selections[i] 大於 0 永遠不成立。

cues.en: And therefore we will directly go to this else here.
cues.zh: 直接進 else。

cues.en: And accordingly the upper bound will be set equal to 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 因此上界設為 10 的 400 次方。

cues.en: Then we move on to this condition because this is the next step of this for loop here.
cues.zh: 接著到下一個條件，這是迴圈下一步。

cues.en: And it says that if upper bound is larger than max upper bound, which is true of course, because upper bound is 10 at the power of 400 and max upper bound is zero.
cues.zh: 檢查 upper_bound 是否大於 max_upper_bound，當然成立，因為上界是 10 的 400 次方，最大值是 0。

cues.en: So this condition is true.
cues.zh: 所以條件為真。

cues.en: So what happens next is that max upper bound is equal to upper bound, so max upper bound will be equal to 10 at the power of 400 and ad equals I.
cues.zh: 接著 max_upper_bound 等於 upper_bound，所以是 10 的 400 次方，ad 等於 i。

cues.en: And so since we're at the beginning of the for loop here, I equals one.
cues.zh: 因為在迴圈開頭，i 等於 1。

cues.en: So ad will be equal to one.
cues.zh: 所以 ad 等於 1。

cues.en: And then what happens?
cues.zh: 接下來呢？

cues.en: Then we go to the next step of this for I loop here which is I equals two.
cues.zh: 進入 for i 下一步，i 等於 2。

cues.en: And I equals two corresponds to the second ad, and the second ad hasn't been selected yet.
cues.zh: i 為 2 對應第二個廣告，尚未選過。

cues.en: So numbers of selections I here will not be larger than zero.
cues.zh: 所以 numbers_of_selections[i] 不大於 0。

cues.en: So this condition will not be true here.
cues.zh: 條件不成立。

cues.en: So again, we will go to this else here.
cues.zh: 再次進 else。

cues.en: And therefore upper bound will be equal to 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 上界等於 10 的 400 次方。

cues.en: And then we go to this if here.
cues.zh: 再到這個 if。

cues.en: So now let's see if this condition is true.
cues.zh: 看看條件成立嗎？

cues.en: Upper bound is equal to 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: upper_bound 等於 10 的 400 次方。

cues.en: And remember from the previous round max upper bound was set equal to 10 at the power of 400 because it was set equal to upper bound.
cues.zh: 記得上一輪迭代，max_upper_bound 已設為 10 的 400 次方，因為它等於當時 upper_bound。

cues.en: So this condition translated in real terms is if 10 at the power of 400 is larger than 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 所以實際條件是：10 的 400 次方是否大於 10 的 400 次方？

cues.en: And that is not true, 10 at the power of 400 is not larger than 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 不成立，它不會大於自己。

cues.en: So that condition is not true and therefore ad is not set equal to two because right now I equals two, but it remains equal to one.
cues.zh: 條件不成立，ad 不會設為 2，雖然 i 是 2，ad 仍為 1。

cues.en: And that's why at the first round the ad that will be selected is ad equals one.
cues.zh: 所以第一回合選中的廣告是 ad = 1。

cues.en: That is the first ad.
cues.zh: 也就是第一個。

cues.en: You can try with the other values of I here, upper bound will always be equal to 10 at the power of 400 and max upper bound will stay equal to 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 可以試其他 i，上界總是 10 的 400 次方，最大上界也維持這個值。

cues.en: So therefore this condition will never be verified for the nine remaining ads here and therefore we keep this ad equals one.
cues.zh: 因此剩餘九個廣告都不會符合這條件，保留 ad = 1。

cues.en: And that's the same principle for the next rounds up to 10.
cues.zh: 後續到第十回合，也相同原理。

cues.en: At round N equals two, this numbers of selections I here will be larger than zero only for the first ad because the first ad was selected at round one.
cues.zh: 回合 n = 2，只有第一個廣告的選取次數大於 0，因為第一回合選過。

cues.en: And therefore this condition will be true only for the first ad.
cues.zh: 所以只有第一個廣告符合條件。

cues.en: So upper bound will be equal to this average reward plus delta I here.
cues.zh: 它的 upper_bound 等於 average_reward 加 delta_i。

cues.en: But then we'll move on to I plus one which will correspond to ad version two.
cues.zh: 接著到下一個 i，對應第二版。

cues.en: And since ad version two wasn't selected yet, well this numbers of selections I here will be equal to zero and therefore this condition won't be verified.
cues.zh: 第二版沒選過，選取次數是 0，條件不成立。

cues.en: And therefore we will go to this else here and upper bound will be equal to 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 進 else，上界是 10 的 400 次方。

cues.en: We will forget this upper bound value here computed at the previous I here.
cues.zh: 不再使用前一個 i 計算的上界值。

cues.en: And therefore what happens next is the same, upper bound will be larger than max upper bound because max upper bound was equal to the upper bound at the previous I and the upper bound of the previous I
cues.zh: 接下來一樣，新上界大於最大值，因為最大值等於上一個 i 的上界，而上一個上界

cues.en: was average reward plus delta I which is of course lower than this 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 是平均獎勵加 delta_i，當然比 10 的 400 次方小。

cues.en: And that's why by the way, we set it to a very large value.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼要設這麼大的值。

cues.en: It's in order to have this upper bound here lower than this 10 at the power of 400 and therefore max upper bound will be 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 讓算出的上界低於 10 的 400 次方，因此 max_upper_bound 會更新為 10 的 400 次方。

cues.en: And we will select ad equals I, that is ad number two.
cues.zh: 選 ad = i，也就是第二個廣告。

cues.en: And then same principle as before, when we'll move on to the next Is, upper bound will be equal to 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 同樣原理，後續 i 的上界都是 10 的 400 次方。

cues.en: Max upper bound will also be equal to 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 最大上界也是 10 的 400 次方。

cues.en: So this condition won't be verified and therefore we will keep ad number two.
cues.zh: 條件不成立，所以保留第二個廣告。

cues.en: So that's why this nice little trick here works perfectly well for us and gives us exactly what we want.
cues.zh: 這個小技巧因此順利運作，得到想要的結果。

cues.en: All right, so the ten first round selected 10 ads and then after round 10 we use this strategy to select the ads.
cues.zh: 前十回合選十個廣告，第十回合後才用這個策略。

cues.en: All right, so now the only thing that we need to do is to append the selected ad here in this ad selected vector here.
cues.zh: 現在只需要把選出的 ad 附加進 ads_selected 向量。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we'll do now.
cues.zh: 正要做這件事。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: We just need to get out of the for I loop because we're done with this loop.
cues.zh: 離開 for i，因為這個迴圈完成了。

cues.en: We did exactly what we had to do, that is to select the right ad.
cues.zh: 已做完要做的，選出正確廣告。

cues.en: And now we need to get out of this for I loop but remain in this for end loop because we are still at a specific round end.
cues.zh: 離開 for i，但留在 for n，因為仍在某個特定回合 n。

cues.en: And what we have to do now is to append the ad that was selected here to this huge vector ad selected that contains all the different ads selected at each round.
cues.zh: 要把剛選的廣告，附加到包含每回合所有選擇的大向量 ads_selected。

cues.en: Okay, so now things are easy, we just need to use the append function on this ads selected huge vector and then append.
cues.zh: 現在很容易，只要對大向量用 append 函式。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 就是這個。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now in this append function, we enter as input, first input ad selected, and second input ad because it corresponds to the index of the ad
cues.zh: append 第一個輸入是 ads_selected，第二個是 ad，因為它對應

cues.en: that was selected in this for I loop here.
cues.zh: for i 選中的廣告索引。

cues.en: All right, so done ad appended, and now, since we've just selected a new ad here, what we need to do is to update this vector number
cues.zh: 廣告附加好了，既然剛選了新的廣告，接著更新 numbers_of_selections，

cues.en: of selections here that as you know, the vector telling for each ad the number of times it was selected.
cues.zh: 這個向量記錄每個廣告的選取次數。

cues.en: So since here we know which index of the ad was just selected, what we need to do is to add a plus one in this particular index of this numbers
cues.zh: 現在知道剛選廣告的索引，只要在這個索引位置加一，

cues.en: of selections vector to update this vector.
cues.zh: 更新向量。

cues.en: So let's do it right now.
cues.zh: 現在做。

cues.en: We will stay of course in this for N loop because this vector will contain the numbers of times each ad was selected at this specific round end.
cues.zh: 當然留在 for n，因為向量記錄截至特定回合 n，每個廣告的選取次數。

cues.en: So we need to stay in the loop and we will simply take this vector here, copy and paste it here to update it.
cues.zh: 留在迴圈，複製這個向量貼到這裡更新。

cues.en: And so what we need to update is the ad index of this numbers of selections vector because this ad index corresponds to the index
cues.zh: 要更新的是 numbers_of_selections 中索引 ad 的元素，因為 ad 對應

cues.en: of the ad that was just selected here, a selection that is based on all the strategy.
cues.zh: 剛根據策略選中的廣告。

cues.en: And so what we simply need to do is increment by one this vector here.
cues.zh: 只要把這個元素加一。

cues.en: So we will copy that again, copy equals paste and then a little plus one here.
cues.zh: 再複製這裡，等於，貼上，再加 + 1。

cues.en: All right, so now this numbers of selections vector is well updated.
cues.zh: numbers_of_selections 正確更新了。

cues.en: And that's all we need to do for this vector.
cues.zh: 這個向量只需要做這些，

cues.en: Add this specific round because of course only one ad was selected.
cues.zh: 因為這個回合只選一個廣告。

cues.en: Okay, and now we need to take care of the rewards because indeed we have this sums of rewards vector here that we need to update because this vector contains
cues.zh: 接著處理獎勵，因為 sums_of_rewards 也得更新，它包含

cues.en: the different sums of rewards of each of the 10 ads at each round.
cues.zh: 每回合十個廣告各自的獎勵總和。

cues.en: So we need to update it.
cues.zh: 所以必須更新。

cues.en: And of course afterwards we would like to get the total reward that you know will be a variable containing the unique sum of rewards we accumulated
cues.zh: 當然之後也想得到 total_reward，用一個變數保存累積於

cues.en: over the N rounds.
cues.zh: N 個回合的總獎勵。

cues.en: So let's first take care of this sums of rewards vector here and then we'll take care of total reward.
cues.zh: 先處理 sums_of_rewards，再處理 total_reward。

cues.en: So to update this sums of rewards vector here what we need to get now is the reward we get at this specific round N, because you know we just selected
cues.zh: 要更新 sums_of_rewards，必須取得這回合 n 的獎勵，因為剛才只是選中

cues.en: this ad here but we haven't got its reward yet.
cues.zh: 這個廣告，還沒得到獎勵。

cues.en: We just selected the ad so far, now we need to get the reward.
cues.zh: 目前只選廣告，現在取獎勵。

cues.en: So in real life what happens is that we show the ad to the user and then the user clicks yes or no on the ad.
cues.zh: 現實中，展示給使用者後，他會點或不點。

cues.en: But here we're not in real life.
cues.zh: 但這裡不是真實環境。

cues.en: As much as I would've loved to show you a real experiment of this right now in front of your eyes this would not be that simple.
cues.zh: 雖然很想當場展示真實實驗，但沒有那麼簡單。

cues.en: But we have this simulation data set, this data set here that contains the real results only known by God,
cues.zh: 不過有這份模擬資料，包含只有上帝知道的真實結果，

cues.en: because we have no idea of which ad each user would click on.
cues.zh: 因為我們不知道每個人會點哪個廣告。

cues.en: So as a reminder, the first user clicks on ad one, ad five and ad nine, not the rest of them.
cues.zh: 提醒第一位會點一、五、九，其他不點。

cues.en: So that's just a simulation data set.
cues.zh: 所以這只是模擬資料。

cues.en: And so what we have to do now is get the reward at each round and based on the ad that was selected, thanks to this data set.
cues.zh: 現在根據所選廣告，透過資料集取得每回合獎勵。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: What we'll simply do is get the reward that is either one or zero at this specific round N where we are at.
cues.zh: 只要取得目前回合 n 的 1 或 0。

cues.en: And so to get this, it's really simple.
cues.zh: 很簡單。

cues.en: What we need to do is take our data set and in the brackets we'll need to specify the index of the line where we are at, which is the round N
cues.zh: 取 dataset，方括號指定目前列索引，也就是回合 n，

cues.en: corresponding to the round where we are right now.
cues.zh: 對應現在的回合。

cues.en: So since all the lines of this data set here are nothing else but the rounds while the first index will be the round.
cues.zh: 資料集所有列都代表回合，所以第一個索引就是回合。

cues.en: So for example, let's say we are at round nine, well, we will need to take the line index nine of the data set and then for the column, since the columns here correspond
cues.zh: 例如第九回合，就取第九列；欄的部分，因為對應

cues.en: to the rewards of the 10 different ads, well, we will need to take the index of the ad that was selected.
cues.zh: 十個廣告的獎勵，就取所選廣告的索引。

cues.en: That is nothing else than this ad index here.
cues.zh: 也就是這個 ad。

cues.en: So that's the idea, that's what we have to do.
cues.zh: 這就是想法，也是要做的。

cues.en: But of course, in real life you'll get what really happens with the users.
cues.zh: 當然現實中，直接取得使用者實際行為。

cues.en: So I'm gonna close this, and right now I'm going to get the real reward at round N that we get with this selection of this ad index here.
cues.zh: 關掉這裡，現在取得回合 n 選中索引 ad 廣告的真實獎勵。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: We will call this real reward, simply reward.
cues.zh: 真實獎勵直接叫 reward。

cues.en: All right, and now as just explained we need to take the data set and then brackets, then we need to take the index of the line that corresponds to round N, so N here.
cues.zh: 剛解釋過，取 dataset，再加方括號，先放回合對應的列索引 n。

cues.en: And then we need to take the index of the column that corresponds to the index of the ad that was just selected.
cues.zh: 再放剛選中廣告對應的欄索引。

cues.en: So it's ad here and that's all.
cues.zh: 就是 ad，就這樣。

cues.en: We simply get the real reward at round N for this specific selection of this ad by using this.
cues.zh: 用這個，就得到回合 n 這個特定廣告選擇的真實獎勵。

cues.en: Okay, so great, we've just got the real reward.
cues.zh: 很好，獎勵取得了。

cues.en: And now we can update this sums of rewards vector here.
cues.zh: 現在能更新 sums_of_rewards 向量。

cues.en: That as a reminder gives to sums of rewards of each of the 10 ads at each round N.
cues.zh: 提醒，它記錄每回合 n，十個廣告各自的獎勵總和。

cues.en: So we will take this, copy and then just below we will increment this vector.
cues.zh: 複製，在下方增加。

cues.en: And of course we need to take the ad index of this vector because only the ad that was selected at this specific round N will have its sum of rewards changed.
cues.zh: 當然取向量索引 ad，因為這回合只有選中廣告的獎勵總和會變。

cues.en: So that's the only sum of rewards we need to update.
cues.zh: 所以只需要更新這一個。

cues.en: And therefore what we need to do is to increment it by the reward, not by one of course, only by the reward because the reward is either a zero or one.
cues.zh: 增加的是 reward，不是直接加一，因為獎勵可能是 0 或 1。

cues.en: So equals here, and then we take that again, and then plus reward.
cues.zh: 等於，再取原值，加 reward。

cues.en: So if we've got a zero reward the sum of rewards for this specific ad won't change.
cues.zh: 若獎勵是 0，這個廣告的總和不變。

cues.en: And if the reward equals one, this sum of rewards for this specific ad will be incremented by one.
cues.zh: 若獎勵是 1，就增加一。

cues.en: Okay, and now we just have to do one last thing.
cues.zh: 現在只剩最後一件事。

cues.en: It's of course to get the total reward accumulated over the N rounds.
cues.zh: 取得 N 回合累積的總獎勵。

cues.en: Well, the total reward is not very interesting for us at any round N, but at the last round N that is at the 10,000 round because we will compare it
cues.zh: 其實不太關心任意回合的 total_reward，而是最後，也就是第一萬回合，因為要把它

cues.zh: 和隨機選擇演算法比較；提醒，隨機平均是 1,200。

cues.en: So that's why we're very excited to find out about this total reward, but at the end of the 10,000 rounds.
cues.zh: 所以非常期待一萬回合結束的總獎勵。

cues.zh: 當然要初始化 total_reward，因為每回合都要更新。

cues.zh: 像物理一樣，需要初始值。
